environment.data: returning signed-in user; empty saved-prayer list
environment.note: Fresh browser context per trial; localhost assets; 4x CPU simulates a slower CPU, not a phone. Native process/WebView startup is excluded.

definitions.layout: First rendering opportunity with the Prayer layout present. After optimization this is a public, inert shell; it cannot accept input.
definitions.editor: First rendering opportunity with the authenticated Prayer textarea present and not disabled. Does not wait for backend requests.
definitions.scope: Web document startup only. These are three-trial medians on desktop Chrome; CPU throttling does not reproduce a real phone or native process/WebView startup.
